Pas lautte huwe rah mein yeh mubarak Surah Aap par nazil hui jis mein is waqiah ka zikr hai aur us sulh ko ba-e'tibar nateejah fateh kaha gaya. Ibn Mas'ud waghairah se marwi hai ke tum to fateh Makkah ko kehte ho lekin hum sulh Hudaibiyah ko fateh jaante thay. Hazrat Jabir se bhi yahi marwi hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Hazrat Bara' farmatay hain tum fateh Makkah ko fateh shumar karte ho aur hum Bai'at-ur-Rizwan ke waqiah Hudaibiyah ko fateh ginte hain. Hum choda sau aadmi Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath is mauqa par thay, Hudaibiyah naami aik kuwaan tha hum ne us mein se paani apni zaroorat ke mutabiq lena shuru kiya thori der mein paani bilkul khatam ho gaya aik qatrah bhi na bacha aakhir paani na honay ki shikayat Huzoor ﷺ ke kaano mein pohanchi, Aap us kuwaan ke paas aaye us ke kinaare baith gaye aur paani ka bartan mangwa kar wuzu kiya jis mein kulli bhi ki phir kuch dua ki aur woh paani us kuwaan mein dalwa diya thori der baad jo hum ne dekha to woh to paani se labalab bhara huwa tha hum ne piya, jaanwaron ne bhi piya, apni haajatein poori keen aur saare bartan bhar liye.

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Umar bin Khattab se marwi hai ke aik safar mein Rasulullah ﷺ ke saath tha teen martaba main ne Aap se kuch poocha Aap ne koi jawab na diya ab to mujhe sakht nadamat hui is amr par ke afsos main ne Huzoor ﷺ ko takleef di, Aap jawab dena nahi chahte aur main khwamخواh sar hota raha. Phir mujhe darr lagne laga ke meri is be-adbi par meray baare mein koi wahi aasmaan se na nazil ho, chunachah main ne apni sawari ko tez kiya aur aage nikal gaya,

Is par yeh ayat (Liyudkhilal-mu'minina wal-mu'minati jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anharu khalidina fiha wa yukaffira anhum sayyi'atihim, wa kana zalika indallahi fawzan azima) (Al-Fath: 5) nazil hui (Bukhari o Muslim). 

Hadrat Majma' bin Harithah Ansari jo qari-e-Quran thay, farmate hain ki Hudaibiyah se hum wapas aa rahe thay ki main ne dekha ki log oonton ko bhagaye liye ja rahe hain, pucha kya baat hai? Maloom hua ki Huzoor ﷺ par koi wahi nazil hui hai, toh hum log bhi apne oonton ko daudate hue sab ke sath pohnche. Aap us waqt Kura'-al-Ghamim mein thay, jab sab jama ho gaye toh aap ne yeh surat tilawat kar ke sunai thi. 

Ek sahabi ne kaha, "Ya Rasulullah ﷺ, kya yeh fath hai?" 
Aap ne farmaya, "Haan, qasam us ki jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, yeh fath hai." 

Khaibar ki taqsim sirf unhi par ki gai jo Hudaibiyah mein mojood thay, atharah hisse banaye gaye, kul lashkar pandrah so ka tha jis mein teen so ghode sawar thay, pas sawar ko dohra hissa mila aur paidal ko ikahra (Abu Dawud waghaira). 

Hadrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud farmate hain ki Hudaibiyah se aate hue ek jagah raat guzarne ke liye hum utar kar so gaye, toh aise soye ki suraj nikalne ke baad jage, dekha Rasulullah ﷺ bhi soye hue hain, hum ne kaha aap ko jagana chahiye, ki aap khud jaag gaye aur farmane lage jo kuch karte thay karo aur isi tarah kare jo so jaye ya bhool jaye. 

Isi safar mein Huzoor ﷺ ki oontni kahin gum ho gayi, hum dhoondne nikle toh dekha ki ek darakhth mein nakil atak gai hai aur woh ruki khadi hai, ise khol kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas laye, aap sawar hue aur hum ne koch kiya. Nagahan raste mein hi aap par wahi aane lagi, wahi ke waqt aap par bohat dushwari hoti thi, jab wahi hat gai toh aap ne hamein bataya ki aap par Surah (Inna fatahna laka fathan mubina) (Al-Fath: 1) utri hai (Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Musnad waghaira). 

Huzoor ﷺ nawafil, tahajjud waghaira mein is qadar waqt lagate ki pairon par warm chadh jata, toh aap se kaha gaya ki kya Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke agle pichle gunah maaf nahi farma diye? 
Aap ne jawab diya, "Kya phir main Allah ka shukr-guzar ghulam na banun?" (Bukhari o Muslim). 
Aur riwayat mein hai ki yeh poochne wali Umm-ul-Mu'minin Aishah R.H theen (Muslim). 

Pas "Mubin" se murad khuli, sarih, saaf zahir hai aur "Fath" se murad Sulh-e-Hudaibiyah hai jis ki wajah se badi khair-o-barakat hasil hui, logon mein amn-o-aman hua, momin kafir mein bol-chal shuru ho gayi, ilm aur iman ke phailane ka moqa mila. 

Aap ke agle pichle gunahon ki mu'afi yeh aap ka khasa hai jis mein koi aap ka sharik nahi. Haan, ba'z a'mal ke sawab mein yeh alfaaz auron ke liye bhi aaye hain. Is mein Huzoor ﷺ ki bohat badi sharafat-o-azmat hai, aap apne tamam kamon mein bhalai, istiqamat aur farmanbardari-e-Ilahi par mustaqim thay, aise ki awwalin o akhirin mein se koi bhi aisa na tha, aap tamam insanon mein sab se zyada akmal insan aur duniya aur akhirat mein kul aulad-e-Adam ke sardar aur rahbar thay.

Aur chunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sab se zyada Allah ke farmanbardar aur sab se zyada Allah ke ahkaam ka lihaz karne wale thay, isi liye jab aap ki oontni aap ko lekar baith gayi toh aap ne farmaya: Isse haathiyon ke rokne wale ne rok liya hai, uski qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, aaj yeh kuffar mujh se jo maangenge doonga, bashartike Allah ki hurmat ki hatk na ho. Pas jab aap ne Allah ki maan li aur sulah ko qubool kar liya toh Allah Azzawajal ne Fath surat utari aur duniya aur aakhirat mein apni neematein aap par poori keen aur shar-e-azeem aur deen-e-qadeem ki taraf aap ki rahbari ki aur aap ke khushoo-o-khuzoo ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne aap ko buland-o-bala kiya, aap ki tawazu, farotani, aajizi aur inkisari ke badle aap ko izz-o-jaah, martaba aur mansab ata farmaya, aap ke dushmanon par aap ko ghalbah diya. Chunache khud aap ka farman hai: Banda darguzar karne se izzat mein barh jata hai aur aajizi aur inkisari karne se bulandi aur aali rutba hasil kar leta hai. 

Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ka qaul hai ke tu ne kisi ko, jis ne tere bare mein Allah Ta'ala ki nafarmani ki ho, aisi saza nahi di ke tu us ke bare mein Allah Ta'ala ki itaat kare.

Ankhon dekha gawah Rasulullah ﷺ Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ko farmata hai hum ne tumhein makhlooq par shahid bana kar, mominon ko khushkhabrian sunane wala kafiron ko daranay wala bana kar bheja hai is ayat ki poori tafsir Surah Ahzab mein guzar chuki hai. Taake aye logon Allah par aur us ke Nabi par iman lao aur us ki azmat-o-ihtram karo buzurgi aur pakeezgi ko tasleem karo aur is liye ke tum Allah Ta'ala ki subh sham tasbeeh karo. Phir Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi ki ta'zeem-o-tukreem bayan farmata hai ke jo log tujh se bai'at karte hain woh darasal khud Allah Ta'ala se hi bai'at karte hain jaise irshad hai ayat (Man yuti'ur-rasula faqad ata'allaha wa man tawalla fama arsalnaka ‘alaihim hafiza) (An-Nisa: 80) yaani jis ne Rasul ﷺ ki itaat ki us ne Allah ka kaha mana Allah ka hath un ke hathon par hai yaani woh un ke sath hai un ki baten sunta hai un ka makan dekhta hai un ke zahir batin ko janta hai pas darasal Rasul ﷺ ke wastay se un se bai'at lene wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai, jaise farmaya ayat (Innallaha ashtara minal-mu'minina anfusahum wa amwalahum bi-anna lahumul-jannah) (At-Tawbah: 111), yaani Allah Ta'ala ne iman walon se un ki janen aur un ke mal khareed liye hain aur un ke badle mein jannat unhein de di hai woh rah-e-Allah mein jihad karte hain marte hain aur marte hain Allah ka yeh sacha wada Torah-o-Injeel mein bhi mojood hai aur is Quran mein bhi samajh lo ke Allah se zyada sachay wade wala kaun hoga? Pas tumhein is khareed-o-farokht par khush hojana chahiye darasal sachi kamyabi yahi hai Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmatay hain jis ne rah-e-Allah mein talwar utha li us ne Allah se bai'at kar li aur hadith mein hai Hajar Aswad ke bare mein Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya isay Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din khada karega is ki do ankhen hongi jin se dekhega aur zaban hogi jis se bolega aur jis ne isay haq ke sath bosa diya hai is ki gawahi dega isay bosa dene wala darasal Allah Ta'ala se bai'at karne wala hai phir ap ne usi ayat ki tilawat ki phir farmata hai jo bai'at ke baad ahad-shakni kare us ka wabaal khud usi par hoga Allah ka woh kuch na bigarega aur jo apni bai'at ko nibha jaye wo bara sawab payega yahan jis bai'at ka zikr hai woh Bai'at-ur-Rizwan hai jo ek babool ke darakht talay Hudaibiyah ke maidan mein hui thi us din bai'at karne wale Sahaba ki tadad terah sau chaudah sau ya pandrah sau thi theek yeh hai ke chaudah sau thi is waqiah ki hadeesain mulahiza hon. Bukhari Sharif mein hai hum us din chaudah sau thay Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai ap ne us pani mein hath rakha pas ap ki ungliyon ke darmiyan se us pani ki sotain ubalnay lagen.

Yeh hadith mukhtasar hai us hadith se jis mein hai ke sahaba sakht pyase huwe pani tha nahi Huzoor ﷺ ne unhe apne tarkash mein se ek teer nikaal kar diya unhone ja kar Hudaibiya ke kuwe mein use gaad diya ab toh pani josh ke sath ubalne laga yahan tak ke sab ko kafi ho gaya. Hazrat Jabir se pucha gaya ke us roz tum kitne the? Farmaya chouda sau lekin agar ek lakh bhi hote toh pani is qadar tha ke sab ko kafi ho jata, Bukhari ki riwayat mein hai ke "pandrah sau the" Hazrat Jabir se ek riwayat mein pandrah sau bhi marwi hai, Imam Baihaqi farmate hain fi-al-waqi the toh pandrah sau aur yahi Hazrat Jabir ka qaul tha phir Aap ko kuch wahm sa ho gaya aur chouda sau farmane lage. Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke sawa pandrah sau the, lekin Aap se mashhoor riwayat chouda sau ki hai aksar rawiyon aur aksar seerat nawees buzurgon ka yahi qaul hai ke chouda sau the. Ek riwayat mein hai Ashab-e-Shajra chouda sau the aur us din athwan hissa Muhajireen ka musalman huwa. Seerat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke Hudaibiya wale saal Rasool Maqbool ﷺ apne sath saat sau sahaba ko le kar ziyarat-e-Baitullah ke irade se Madina se chale qurbani ke sattar oont bhi Aap ke hamrah the har das ashخاص (ashkhas) ki taraf se ek oont. Haan Hazrat Jabir se riwayat hai ke Aap ke sathi us din chouda sau the, Ibn Ishaq isi tarah kehte hain aur yeh un ke auham mein shumar hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim jo mehfooz hai woh yeh ke ek hazar kayi sau the jaise abhi aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala.

Is Bait ka sabab Sirat Muhammad bin Ishaq mein hai ke phir Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Umar ko bulwaya ke aap ko Makkah bhej kar Quresh ke sardaron se kahwayan ke Huzoor ﷺ larai bharai ke irade se nahi aaye balkay aap Baitullah Sharif ke umrah ke liye aaye hain lekin Hazrat Umar ne farmaya Ya Rasulullah ﷺ mere khayal se to is kaam ke liye aap Hazrat Usman ko bhejiye kyunke Makkah mein mere khandan mein se koi nahi yani Banu Adi bin Ka'ab ka qabila nahi jo meri himayat kare aap jante hain ke Quresh se main ne kitni kuch aur kya kuch dushmani ki hai aur woh mujh se woh kis qadar khar khaye hue hain mujhe to woh zinda hi nahi chhodenge chanacha Huzoor ﷺ ne is raye ko pasand farma kar Janab Usman Zun-Noorain ko Abu Sufyan aur sardaran-e-Quresh ke paas bheja aap ja hi rahe the ke raste mein ya Makkah mein dakhil hote hi Abaan bin Saeed bin Aas mil gaya aur us ne aap ko apne aage sawari par bitha liya apni amaan mein unhein apne sath Makkah mein le gaya aap Quresh ke bado ke paas gaye aur Huzoor ﷺ ka paigham pahunchaya unhon ne kaha ke agar aap Baitullah Sharif ka tawaf karna chahein to kar lijiye aap ne jawab diya ke yeh namumkin hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ se pehle main tawaf karloon, ab un logon ne Janab Zun-Noorain ko rok liya udhar lashkar-e-Islam mein yeh khabar mashhoor hogayi ke Hazrat Usman ko shaheed kar dala gaya, is wehshat asar khabar ne musalmanon ko aur khud Rasulullah ﷺ ko bada sadma pahunchaya aur aap ne farmaya ke ab to hum baghair faisla kiye yahan se nahi hatenge, chanacha aap ﷺ ne sahaba ko bulwaya aur un se bait li ek darakht tale yeh Bait-ur-Rizwan hui. Log kehte hain yeh bait maut par li thi yani larte larte mar jayenge lekin Hazrat Jabir ka bayan hai ke maut par bait nahi li thi balkay is iqrar par ke hum larai se bhagenge nahi jitne musalman sahaba is maidan mein the sab ne aap se ba-razamandi bait ki siwaye Jad bin Qais ke jo qabila Banu Salma ka ek shakhs tha yeh apni oontni ki aad mein chhup gaya phir Huzoor ﷺ aur sahaba ko maloom hogaya ke Hazrat Usman ki shahadat ki afwah ghalat thi is ke baad Quresh ne Suhail bin Amr, Huwaitib bin Abdul Uzza aur Makraz bin Hafs ko aap ke paas bheja yeh log abhi yahin the ke ba'z musalmanon aur ba'z mushrikeen mein kuch tez kalamhi shuru hogayi nobat yahan tak pohnchi ke sang bari aur teer bari bhi hui aur dono taraf ke log aamne samne hogaye udhar un logon ne Hazrat Usman waghaira ko rok liya udhar yeh log ruk gaye aur Rasulullah ﷺ ke munadi ne nida kardi ke Rooh-ul-Quds Allah ke Rasul ﷺ ke paas aaye aur bait ka hukum de gaye aao Allah ka naam lekar bait kar jao ab kya tha musalman betabana doure hue hazir hue aap us waqt darakht tale the sab ne bait ki is baat par ke woh hargiz hargiz kisi soorat mein maidan se munh modne ka naam na lenge is se mushrikeen kanp uthe aur jitne musalman un ke paas the sab ko chhod diya aur sulh ki darkhwast karne lage.

Baihaqi mein hai ke baiyat ke waqt Allah ke Rasul ﷺ ne farmaya: Ilahi! Usman tere aur tere Rasul ﷺ ke kaam ko gaye hue hain, pas Aap ne khud apna ek haath apne dusre haath par rakha, goya Hazrat Usman ki taraf se baiyat ki. Pas Hazrat Usman ke liye Rasulullah ﷺ ka haath unke apne haath se bahut afzal tha. Is baiyat mein sab se pehal karne wale Hazrat Abu Sinan Asadi R.A the. Unhon ne sab se aage barh kar farmaya: Huzur ﷺ! Haath phailaiye taaki main baiyat karloon. Aap ne farmaya: Kis baat par baiyat karte ho? Jawab diya: Jo aap ke dil mein ho us par. Aap ke walid ka naam Wahab tha.

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Nafi se marwi hai ke log kehte hain Hazrat Umar ke larke Hazrat Abdullah ne apne walid se pehle Islam qubool kiya, darasal waqia yun nahi. Baat yeh hai ke Hudaibiya wale saal Hazrat Umar ne apne sahibzade Hazrat Abdullah ko ek Ansari ke paas bheja ke ja kar apne ghore le aao, us waqt Rasulullah ﷺ logon se baiyat le rahe the, Hazrat Umar ko iska ilm na tha, yeh apne taur poshidagi se larai ki taiyariyan kar rahe the. Hazrat Abdullah ne dekha ke Huzur ﷺ ke haath par baiyat ho rahi hai toh yeh baiyat se musharraf hue, phir ghora lene gaye aur ghora la kar Hazrat Umar ke paas aaye aur kaha: Huzur ﷺ baiyat le rahe hain. Ab Janab Farooq aaye aur Huzur ﷺ ke haath par baiyat ki. Is bina par log kehte hain ke bete ka Islam baap se pehle ka hai.

Bukhari ki dusri riwayat mein hai: Log alag alag darakhton tale aaram kar rahe the ke Hazrat Umar ne dekha ke har ek ki nigahein Huzur ﷺ par hain aur log Aap ko ghere hue hain. Hazrat Abdullah se farmaya: Jao zara dekho toh kya ho raha hai? Yeh aaye, dekha ke baiyat ho rahi hai toh baiyat kar li, phir ja kar Hazrat Umar ko khabar ki, chunancha Aap bhi foran aaye aur baiyat se musharraf hue.

Hazrat Jabir ka bayan hai ke jab hum ne baiyat ki hai us waqt Hazrat Umar Farooq Aap ka haath thame hue the aur Aap ek babool ke darakht tale the. 

Hazrat Maqal bin Yasar ka bayan hai ke is mauqa par darakht ki ek jhuki hui shaakh ko Aap ke sar se upar ko utha kar main thame hue tha, hum ne Aap se maut par baiyat nahi ki balki na bhagne par. 

Hazrat Salma bin Akwa farmate hain ke hum ne marne par baiyat ki thi. Aap farmate hain: Ek martaba baiyat kar ke main hat kar ek taraf ko khada ho gaya toh Aap ne mujh se farmaya: Sal

Maine kaha ya Rasulullah ﷺ pehli martaba jin logon ne bai'at ki main ne un ke sath hi bai'at ki thi phir beech mein dobaara bai'at kar chuka hoon, Aap ne farmaya acha phir sahi, chunacha is akhri jama'at ke sath bhi main ne bai'at ki. Aap ne phir meri taraf dekh kar farmaya Salma tumhein hum ne jo dhal di thi woh kya hui? Maine kaha ya Rasulullah ﷺ Hazrat Amir se meri mulaqat hui to main ne dekha ke un ke pas dushman ka war rokne wali koi cheez nahi, main ne woh dhal unhein de di, to Aap hanse aur farmaya tum bhi us shakhs ki tarah ho jis ne Allah se dua ki ke aye Ilahi mere pas kisi aise ko bhej de jo mujhe meri jaan se zyada azeez ho. 

Phir Ahl-e-Makkah se sulh ki tehreek ki amad-o-raft hui aur sulh ho gayi. Main Hazrat Talha bin Ubaidullah ka khadim tha, un ke ghore ki aur un ki khidmat kya karta tha, woh mujhe khane ko de dete the, main to apna ghar bar, bal bachay, maal daulat sab rah-e-Khuda mein chor kar hijrat kar ke chala aya tha. Jab sulh ho chuki, idhar ke log udhar, udhar ke idhar anay lage to main ek darakht tale ja kar kante waghera hata kar us ki jar se lag kar so gaya. Achank mushrikeen-e-Makkah mein se chaar shakhs wahin aye aur Huzoor ﷺ ki shan mein kuch gustakhana kalmaat se aapas mein baatein karne lage, mujhe bara bura maloom hua, main wahan se uth kar doosre darakht tale chala gaya. Ab logon ne apne hathiyar utare, darakht par latka kar wahan lait gaye. 

Thori der guzri hogi jo main ne suna ke wadi ke neeche ke hisse se koi munadi nida kar raha hai ke aye Muhajir bhaiyo! Hazrat Dahim qatl kar diye gaye hain. Main ne jhat se talwar tan li aur usi darakht tale gaya jahan chaaron soye hue the, jatay hi pehle to un ke hathiyar qabze mein kiye aur apne ek hath mein unhein daba kar doosre hath se talwar tol kar un se kaha suno! Us Allah ki kasam jis ne Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ko izzat di hai, tum mein se jis ne bhi sar uthaya main us ka sar qalam kar doonga. Jab woh isay maan chuke main ne kaha utho aur mere agay agay chalo. Chunacha un chaaron ko le kar main Rasulullah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua. 

Idhar mere chacha Hazrat Amir bhi Makraz nami Ublat ke ek mushrik ko giraftar kar ke laye aur bhi isi tarah ke sattar mushrikeen Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir kiye gaye the. Aap ne un ki taraf dekha aur farmaya unhein chor do, burai ki ibtida bhi inhi ke sar rahe aur phir is ki takrar ke zimma dar bhi yehi rahenge. Chunacha un sab ko riha kar diya gaya. Isi ka bayan ayat: 
(Wa huwa allazi kaffa aidiyahum ankum wa aidiyakum anhum bi-batni Makkah min ba'di an azfarakum alaihim wa kanallahu bima ta'amaloona baseera 24) (Surah (Al-Fath: 24) mein hai.

Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib ke walid bhi is mauqe par Huzoor ﷺ ke sath thay, aap ka bayan hai ke agle saal jab hum Hajj ko gaye toh us darakht ki jagah hum par poshida rahi hum maloom na kar sake ke kis jagah Huzoor ﷺ ke hath par hum ne bay'at ki thi, ab agar tum par yeh poshidagi khul gayi ho toh tum jano. 

Ek riwayat mein Hazrat Jabir R.A se marwi hai ke us waqt Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: "Aaj zameen par jitne hain un sab par afzal tum log ho." Aap farmate hain: "Agar meri ankhein hotin toh main tumhe us darakht ki jagah dikha deta." Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain is jagah ke ta'ayyun mein bara ikhtilaf hai. 

Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke jin logon ne is bay'at mein شرکت (shirkat) ki hai un mein se koi jahannam mein nahi jayega (Bukhari o Muslim). Aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: "Jin logon ne is darakht taley mere hath par bay'at ki hai sab jannat mein jayenge magar surkh oont wala." Hum jaldi daude, dekha toh ek shakhs apne khoye hue oont ki talash mein tha. Hum ne kaha: "Chal bay'at kar." Us ne jawab diya ke bay'at se zyada nafa toh is mein hai ke main apna gum shuda oont pa loon. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, aap ne farmaya: "Kaun hai jo Saniyat-ul-Muraar par charh jaye?" Us se woh door ho jayega jo Bani Israel se door hua. Pas sab se pehle qabila Khazraj ke ek sahabi is par charh gaye, phir toh aur log bhi pahunch gaye. Phir aap ne farmaya: "Tum sab bakhshe jaoge magar surkh oont wala." Hum us ke paas aaye aur us se kaha: "Tere liye Rasoolullah ﷺ se istighfar talab karein?" Toh us ne jawab diya: "Allah ki qasam! Mujhe mera oont mil jaye toh main zyada khush hoon ba nisbat is ke ke tumhare sahib mere liye istighfar karein." Yeh shakhs apna gum shuda oont dhoond raha tha. 

Hazrat Hafsa R.A ne jab Huzoor ﷺ ki zubani yeh suna ke is bay'at wale dozakh mein dakhil nahi honge toh kaha: "Haan, honge." Aap ne unhein rok diya toh Mai Sahiba ne ayat parhi: (Wa in minkum illa wariduha, kana ‘ala rabbika hatman maqdiyya) 19. Maryam: 71. Yani tum mein se har shakhs ko is par warid hona hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: "Is ke baad hi farman-e-bari hai: (Summa nunajj-allazina-ttaqau wa nazaru-zzalimeena fiha jisiyya) 19. Maryam: 72. Yani phir hum taqwa walon ko nijaat denge aur zalimon ko ghutnon ke bal is mein gira denge" (Muslim). 

Hazrat Hatib bin Abi Balta'ah ke ghulam Hazrat Hatib ki shikayat le kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kehne lage: "Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Hatib zaroor jahannam mein jayenge." Aap ne farmaya: "Tu jhootha hai, woh jahannami nahi, woh Badr mein aur Hudaibiya mein mojood raha." 

In buzurgon ki sana bayan ho rahi hai ke yeh Allah se bay'at kar rahe hain, in ke hathon par Allah ka hath hai. Is bay'at ko todne wala apna hi nuqsaan karne wala hai aur ise poora karne wala bare ajr ka mustahiq hai jaisa ke farmaya: (Laqad radiyallahu ‘anil-mu’minina iz yubayi’unaka tahtash-shajarati fa ‘alima ma fi qulubihim fa anzalas-sakinata ‘alaihim wa ashabahum fathan qariba) 48.

(Al-Fath: 18), yaani Allah Ta'ala iman walon se raazi hogaya jabke unhon ne darakht tale tujh se bay'at ki, un ke dili iradon ko us ne jaan liya, phir un par dil-jam'i nazil farmayi aur qareeb ki fath se unhain sarfraz farmaya.)

To aap unhein jawab de dena ke tumhara maamla supurd-e-Khuda hai woh dilon ke bhed se waqif hai agar woh tumhein nuqsaan pohnchaye toh kaun hai jo use dafa kar sake? Aur agar woh tumhein nafa dena chahe toh kaun hai jo use rok sake? Tasannu' aur banawat se tumhari imandari aur nifaq se woh ba-khoobi aagah hai ek ek amal se woh ba-khabar hai is par koi cheez makhfi nahi darasl tumhara peechhe reh jana kisi uzr ke baais na tha balki ba-taur na-farmani ke hi tha. Saaf taur par tumhara nifaq is ke baais tha tumhare dil iman se khali hain Allah par bharosa nahi Rasool ﷺ ki ita'at mein bhalai ka yaqeen nahi is wajah se tumhari jaanein tum par giraan hain tum apni nisbat toh kya balki Rasool Allah ﷺ aur Sahaba-e-Rasool ﷺ ki nisbat bhi yahi khayal karte thay ke yeh qatal kar diye jaayenge un ki bhusi ura di jayegi un mein se ek bhi na bach sakega jo un ki khabar toh la kar de, in bad-khayaliyon ne tumhein namard bana rakha tha tum darasl barbad-shuda log ho kaha gaya hai ke (bura) lughat-e-Oman hai jo shakhs apna amal khalis na kare apna aqeeda mazboot na bana le use Allah Ta'ala dozakh ki aag mein azaab karega go duniya mein woh ba-khilaf apne batin ke zahir karte rahe phir Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apne mulk apne shehanshahi aur apne ikhtiyarat ka bayan farmata hai ke malik-o-mutasarrif wahi hai bakhshish aur azaab par qadir woh hai lekin hai Ghafoor aur Raheem jo bhi us ki taraf jhuke woh us ki taraf mail ho jata hai aur jo us ka dar khatkhataye woh us ke liye apna darwaza khol deta hai khwah kitne hi gunah kiye hon jab tauba kare Allah qabul farma leta hai aur gunah bakhsh deta hai balki raham aur meharbani se pesh aata hai.

Saaf taur par tumhara nifaq is ke baais tha tumhare dil iman se khali hain Allah par bharosa nahi Rasool ﷺ ki ita'at mein bhalai ka yaqeen nahi is wajah se tumhari jaanein tum par giraan hain tum apni nisbat toh kya balki Rasool Allah ﷺ aur Sahaba-e-Rasool ﷺ ki nisbat bhi yahi khayal karte thay ke yeh qatal kar diye jaayenge un ki bhusi ura di jayegi un mein se ek bhi na bach sakega jo un ki khabar toh la kar de, in bad-khayaliyon ne tumhein namard bana rakha tha tum darasl barbad-shuda log ho kaha gaya hai ke (bura) lughat-e-Oman hai jo shakhs apna amal khalis na kare apna aqeeda mazboot na bana le use Allah Ta'ala dozakh ki aag mein azaab karega go duniya mein woh ba-khilaf apne batin ke zahir karte rahe phir Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala apne mulk apne shehanshahi aur apne ikhtiyarat ka bayan farmata hai ke malik-o-mutasarrif wahi hai bakhshish aur azaab par qadir woh hai lekin hai Ghafoor aur Raheem jo bhi us ki taraf jhuke woh us ki taraf mail ho jata hai aur jo us ka dar khatkhataye woh us ke liye apna darwaza khol deta hai khwah kitne hi gunah kiye hon jab tauba kare Allah qabul farma leta hai aur gunah bakhsh deta hai balki raham aur meharbani se pesh aata hai.

Maal-e-Ghanimat ke Talib 
Irshad-e-Ilahi hai ke jin badwi logon ne Hudaibiyah mein Allah ke Rasool aur Sahaba ka sath na diya woh jab Huzoor ﷺ ko aur un Sahaba ko Khaibar ki fath ke mauqa par maal-e-ghanimat samaitne ke liye jate hue dekhenge toh arzoo karenge ke humein bhi apne sath le lo, museebat ko dekh kar peeche hat gaye rahat ko dekh kar shamil hona chahte hain is liye Allah Ta'ala ne hukum diya ke unhein hargiz sath na lena jab yeh jang se ji churayein toh phir ghanimat mein hissa kyun lein? 

Allah Ta'ala ne Khaibar ki ghanimaton ka wada Ahl-e-Hudaibiyah se kiya hai na ke un se jo kathin waqt par sath na dein aur aaram ke waqt mil jayen. Inki chahat hai ke Kalam-e-Ilahi ko badal dein yaani Allah ne toh sirf Hudaibiyah ki hazri walon se wada kiya toh yeh chahte hain ke bawajood apni ghair-hazri ke Allah ke is wade mein mil jayen taake woh bhi badla hua sabit ho jaye. 

Ibn Zaid kehte hain murad is se yeh hukum-e-ilahi hai: (Fa in raja'akallahu ila ta'ifatim minhum fastazanuka lil-khuruji faqul lan takhruju ma'iya abadan wa lan tuqatilu ma'iya aduwwan) [9. At-Tawbah: 83], yaani Aie Nabi agar tumhein Allah Ta'ala un mein se kisi giroh ki taraf wapas le jaye aur woh tum se jihad ke liye nikalne ki ijazat mangein toh tum un se keh dena ke tum mere sath hargiz na niklo aur mere sath ho kar kisi dushman se na laro tum wohi ho ke pehli martafa hum se peeche reh jane mein hi khush rahe pas ab hamesha baithe rehne walon ke sath hi baithe raho. 

Lekin is qaul mein nazar hai is liye ke yeh aayat Surah Barat ki hai jo Ghazwah Tabuk ke bare mein nazil hui hai aur Ghazwah Tabuk Ghazwah Hudaibiyah ke bohat baad ka hai. 

Ibn Juraij ka qaul hai ke murad is se un munafiqon ka musalmanon ko bhi apne sath mila kar jihad se baaz rakhna hai. Farmata hai ke unhein un ki is arzoo ka jawab do ke tum hamare sath chalna chaho is se pehle Allah yeh wada Ahl-e-Hudaibiyah se kar chuka hai is liye tum hamare sath nahi chal sakte. Ab woh taana denge ke acha humein maloom ho gaya tum hum se jalte ho tum nahi chahte ke ghanimat ka hissa tumhare siwa kisi aur ko mile. Allah farmata hai darasal yeh unki nasamjhi hai aur isi ek par kya mauqoof hai yeh log sarasar be-samajh hain.

Woh sakht ladaaka kaum jin se ladne ki taraf yeh bulaaye jaayenge kaunsi kaum hai? Is mein kayi aqwaal hain, ek toh yeh ke is se murad qabeela Hawazin hai, doosre yeh ke is se murad qabeela Thaqif hai, teesre yeh ke is se murad qabeela Banu Hanifa hai, chauthe yeh ke is se murad Ahl-e-Faris hain, paanchwein yeh ke is se murad Roomi hain, chhatwein yeh ke is se murad but-parast hain. Baaz farmate hain is se murad koi khaas qabeela ya giroh nahi balki mutlaq jangju kaum murad hai jo abhi tak muqabla mein nahi aayi. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.H farmate hain is se murad koi khaas qabeela ya giroh nahi balki mutlaq jangju kaum murad hai jo abhi tak muqabla mein nahi aayi. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.H farmate hain is se murad Kurd log hain. Ek marfoo' hadees mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak ke tum ek aisi kaum se na lado jin ki aankhein chhoti chhoti hongi aur naak baithi hui hogi, un ke munh misl teh-ba-teh dhaalon ke honge. Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain is se murad Turk hain. Ek hadees mein hai ke tumhein ek kaum se jihad karna padega jin ki jootiyan baal-dar hongi. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.H farmate hain is se murad Kurd log hain. Phir farmata hai ke un se jihad-o-qital tum par mashroo' kar diya gaya hai aur yeh hukm baaqi hi rahega. Allah Ta'ala un par tumhari madad karega ya yeh ke woh khud-ba-khud baghair lade-bhade Deen-e-Islam qubool kar lenge. Phir irshad hota hai agar tum maan loge aur jihad ke liye uth khade hoge aur hukm ki baja-aavari karoge toh tumhein bahut saari nekiyan milengi aur agar tum ne wohi kiya jo Hudaibiya ke mauqe par kiya tha yaani buzdili se baithe rahe, jihad mein sharakat na ki, ahkaam ki ta'amil se jee churaya toh tumhein almanaq azaab hoga. Phir jihad ke tark karne ke jo sahih uzr hain un ka bayaan ho raha hai, pas do uzr toh woh bayaan farmaaye jo lazmi hain yaani andha-pan aur langda-pan aur ek uzr woh bayaan farmaya jo aarzi hai jaise beemari ke chand din rahi phir chali gayi. Pas yeh bhi apni beemari ke zamaane mein ma'zoor hain, haan tandrust hone ke baad yeh ma'zoor nahi. Phir jihad ki targheeb dete hue farmate hain ke Allah-o-Rasool ﷺ ka farmanbardar jannati hai aur jo jihad se be-raghbti kare aur duniya ki taraf sarasar mutawajjah ho jaye, ma'ash ke peeche ma'ad ko bhool jaye, us ki saza duniya mein zillat aur aakhirat ki dukh maar hai.

Chaudah sau Sahaba aur Bait-e-Rizwan pehle bayaan ho chuka hai ke yeh bait karne wale chaudah sau ki tadad mein the aur yeh darakht babool ka tha jo Hudaibiya ke maidan mein tha, Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Abdur Rahman jab Hajj ko gaye toh dekha ke kuch log ek jagah namaz ada kar rahe hain, pucha ke kya baat hai? Toh jawab mila ke yeh wahi darakht hai jahan Rasulullah ﷺ se Bait-e-Rizwan hui thi. Hazrat Abdur Rahman ne wapas aakar yeh qissa Hazrat Saeed bin Musayyib se bayaan kiya toh aap ne farmaya mere walid sahab bhi un bait karne walon mein the, unka bayaan hai ke bait ke doosre saal hum wahan gaye lekin hum sab ko bhula diya gaya, woh darakht humein na mila, phir Hazrat Saeed farmane lage taajjub hai ke Ashab-e-Rasul ﷺ se bhi zyada janne wale ho. Phir farmaya hai unki dili sadaqat, niyat, wafa aur sunne aur manne wali aadat ko Allah ne maloom kar liya, pas unke dilon mein itminan daal diya aur qareeb ki fath inaam farmai. Yeh fath woh sulh hai jo Hudaibiya ke maidan mein hui jis se aam bhalai hasil hui aur jis ke qareeb hi Khaibar fath hua, phir thode hi zamane ke baad Makkah bhi fath ho gaya, phir aur qile aur ilaqe bhi fath hote chale gaye. Aur woh izzat-o-nusrat-o-fath-o-zafar-o-iqbal aur raf-at hasil hui ke duniya angusht-ba-dandan hairan-o-pareshan reh gayi. Isi liye farmaya ke bohat si ghanimatein ata farmayega. Sache ghalbe wala aur kamil hikmat wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai hum Hudaibiya ke maidan mein dopahar ke waqt aaram kar rahe the ke Rasulullah ﷺ ke munadi ne nida ki ke logo bait ke liye aage badho Ruh-ul-Quds aa chuke hain. Hum bhage daude hazir-e-huzoor ﷺ hue, aap us waqt babool ke darakht tale the, hum ne aap ke hath par bait ki jiska zikr aayat (Laqad radiyallahu 'anil-mu'minina iz yubayi'unaka tahtasy-shajarati fa'alima ma fi qulubihim fa anzalas-sakinata 'alaihim wa ashabahum fathan qariba) (Surah (Al-Fath: 18) mein hai. Hazrat Usman ki taraf se aap ne apna hath doosre hath par rakh kar khud hi bait kar li, toh hum ne kaha Usman bade khushnaseeb rahe ke hum toh yahan pade hue hain aur woh Baitullah ka tawaf kar rahe honge, yeh sun kar Janab Rasul Maqbul ﷺ ne farmaya bilkul namumkin hai ke Usman hum se pehle tawaf kar le go kayi saal tak wahan rahe.)

Kuffar ke bad iraday nakaam huwe. In bahut si ganeemton se murad aap ke zamane aur baad ki sab ganeemtein hain. Jaldi ki ganeem se murad Khaibar ki ganeemat hai aur Hudaibiyah ki sulah hai. Is Allah ka ek ehsan yeh bhi hai ke kuffar ke bad iradon ko us ne poora na hone diya, na Makkah ke kafiron ke, na un munafiqon ke jo tumhare peeche Madine mein rahe thay. Na yeh tum par hamla-awar ho sake na woh tumhare baal-bachon ko sata sake. Yeh is liye ke musalman is se ibrat hasil karein aur jaan lein ke asal hafiz-o-nasir Allah hi hai, pas dushmanon ki kasrat aur apni qillat se himmat na haar dein aur yeh bhi yaqeen kar lein ke har kaam ke anjam ka ilm Allah hi ko hai.

Bandon ke haq mein behtari yahi hai ke woh us ke farman par amil rahein aur usi mein apni khairiyat samjhein go woh farman ba-zahir khilaf-e-taba ho. Bahut mumkin hai ke tum jise na-pasand rakhte ho wahi tumhare haq mein behtar ho. Woh tumhe tumhare hukm baja-awari aur ittaba-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur sachi jan-nisari ki awaz rah-e-mustaqeem dikhayega aur digar ganeemtein aur fath-mandiyan bhi ata farmayega jo tumhare bas ki nahi lekin Allah khud tumhari madad karega aur un mushkilat ko tum par asan kar dega. Sab cheezein Allah ke bas mein hain, woh apna dar rakhne wale bandon ko aisi jagah se roziyan pohanchata hai jo kisi ke khayal mein to kya? Khud un ke apne khayal mein bhi na hon. 

Is ganeemat se murad Khaibar ki ganeemat hai jis ka wada sulah-e-Hudaibiyah mein panhan tha ya Makkah ki fath thi ya Faris aur Room ke maal hain ya woh tamam fatoohat hain jo qayamat tak musalmanon ko hasil hongi. 

Phir Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala musalmanon ko khushkhabri sunata hai ke woh kuffar se mar'oob aur khaif na hon. Agar kafir muqabla par aye to Allah apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur musalmanon ki madad karega aur un be--imanon ko shikast-e-fash dega. Yeh peeth dikhayenge aur munh pher lenge aur koi wali aur madadgar bhi inhein na milega is liye ke woh Allah aur us ke Rasool se larte ke liye aye hain aur us ke imandar bandon ke peeche pare hue hain. 

Phir farmata hai yahi Allah Ta'ala ki adat hai ke jab kufr-o-iman ka muqabla ho woh iman ko kufr par ghalib karta hai aur haq ko zahir kar ke batil ko daba deta hai, jaise ke Badr wale din bahut se kafiron ko jo ba-saman thay chand musalmanon ke muqabla mein jo be-sar-o-saman thay shikast-e-fash di.

Phir Allah Subhanahu Wa Ta'ala farmata hai mere ehsan ko bhi na bhulo ke maine mushrikon ke haath tum tak na pahunchne diye aur tumhein bhi Masjid-e-Haram ke paas ladne se rok diya aur tum mein aur un mein suleh kara di jo darasal tumhare haq mein sarasar behtari hai kya duniya ke aitbaar se aur kya aakhirat ke aitbaar se. Woh hadith yaad hogi jo isi surat ki tafsir mein ba-riwayat Hazrat Salmah bin Akwa' guzar chuki hai ke jab sattar kafiron ko baandh kar sahaba ne Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat-e-aqdas mein pesh kiya to Aap ne farmaya unhein jaane do unki taraf se hi ibtida ho aur unhi ki taraf se dobara shuru ho. Isi baabat yeh ayat utri, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke wahi kafir hathiyaron se aarasta Jabal (Tan'eem) ki taraf se chupchapate mauqa pa kar utar aaye lekin Huzoor ﷺ ghafil na the Aap ne foran logon ko aagah kar diya sab giraftar kar liye gaye aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh kiye gaye Aap ne azrah-e-meherbani unki khata maaf farma di aur sab ko chhod diya. Aur Nasai mein bhi hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Mughaffal farmate hain jis darakht ka zikr Quran mein hai uske neeche Nabi ﷺ the hum log bhi Aap ke ardegird the is darakht ki shakhein Huzoor ﷺ ki kamar se lag rahi thi, Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib aur Suhail bin Amr Aap ke samne the, Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Ali se farmaya Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim likho, is par Suhail ne Huzoor ﷺ ka haath thaam liya aur kaha hum Rahman aur Rahim ko nahi jaante hamare is suleh-namah mein hamare dastoor ke mutabiq likhwaiye, pas Aap ne farmaya (Bismikallahumma) likh lo. Phir likha yeh woh hai jis par Allah ke Rasool Muhammad ﷺ ne Ahl-e-Makkah se suleh ki, is par phir Suhail ne Aap ka haath thaam kar kaha Aap Rasoolullah ﷺ hi hain to phir hum ne bada zulm kiya is suleh-namah mein wahi likhwaiye jo hum mein mashhoor hai, to Aap ne farmaya likho yeh woh hai jis par Muhammad bin Abdullah ﷺ ne Ahl-e-Makkah se suleh ki. Itne mein tees naujawan kuffar hathiyar-band aan pade Aap ne unke haq mein baddua ki Allah ne unhein behra bana diya, hum uthe aur un sab ko giraftar kar ke Aap ke samne pesh kar diya. Aap ne un se daryaft farmaya ke kya tumhein kisi ne aman diya hai? Ya tum kisi ki zimmedari par aaye ho? Unhon ne inkaar kiya lekin bawajood is ke Aap ne un se dar-guzar farmaya aur unhein chhod diya, is par yeh ayat (Wa Huwal-Lazi) al-ayah nazil hui (Nasai). Ibn Jarir mein hai jab Huzoor ﷺ qurbani ke janwar lekar chale aur Zul-Hulaifah tak pahunch gaye to Hazrat Umar ne arz ki Aye Nabi Allah ﷺ Aap ek aisi kaum ki basti mein ja rahe hain jo bar-sar-e-paikar hain aur aap ke paas na to hathiyar hain na asbaab, Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh sun kar aadmi bhej kar Madinah se sab hathiyar aur kul saaman mangwa liya jab Aap Makkah ke qareeb pahunch gaye to mushrikeen ne Aap ko roka ke Aap Makkah na aayein, Aap ko khabar di ke Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl paanch sau ka lashkar lekar Aap par chadhai karne ke liye aa raha hai, Aap ne Hazrat Khalid bin Walid se farmaya Aye Khalid tera chachazad bhai lashkar lekar aa raha hai, Hazrat Khalid ne farmaya phir kya hua?

mein Allah ki talwar hoon aur us ke Rasul ﷺ ki usi din se aap ka laqab Saifullah huwa. Mujhe aap jahan chahein aur jis ke muqabla mein chahein bhejein chunacha Ikrama ke muqabla ke liye aap rawanah huwe ghaati mein dono ki mudbhed huwi Hazrat Khalid ne aisa sakht hamla kiya ke Ikrama ke paon nah jame usay Makkah ki galiyon tak pohancha kar Hazrat Khalid wapas aagaye lekin phir dobarah woh tazah dam ho kar muqabla par aaya ab ki martaba bhi shikast k kha kar Makkah ki galiyon mein pohanch gaya woh phir teesri martaba nikla is martaba bhi yehi hashar huwa usi ka bayan aayat (Wa huwal-lazii kaffa aydiyahum 'ankum wa aydiyakum 'anhum bi-batni Makkah min ba'di an azfarakum 'alayhim wa kanallahu bima ta'maluna basira 24) (Al-Fath: 24) mein hai, pas Allah Ta'ala ne bawajood Huzoor ﷺ ki zafar-mandi ke kuffar ko bhi bacha liya taake jo musalman zu'afa aur kamzor Makkah mein the unhein islami lashkar ke hathon koi gazand nah pohnchay lekin is riwayat mein bohat kuch nazar hai namumkin hai ke yeh Hudaibiyah wale waqiah ka zikar ho is liye ke us waqt tak to Hazrat Khalid musalman hi nah huwe the balkey mushrikeen ke talayah ke yeh us din sardar the jaise ke sahih hadith mein maujood hai aur yeh bhi nahi ho sakta ke yeh waqiah Umrat-ul-Qada ka ho. Isi baabat yeh ayat utri, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke wahi kafir hathiyaron se aarasta Jabal (Tan'eem) ki taraf se chupchapate mauqa pa kar utar aaye lekin Huzoor ﷺ ghafil na the Aap ne foran logon ko aagah kar diya sab giraftar kar liye gaye aur Huzoor ﷺ ke samne pesh kiye gaye Aap ne azrah-e-meherbani unki khata maaf farma di aur sab ko chhod diya. Itne mein tees naujawan kuffar hathiyar-band aan pade Aap ne unke haq mein baddua ki Allah ne unhein behra bana diya, hum uthe aur un sab ko giraftar kar ke Aap ke samne pesh kar diya. Kuffar ke bad iraday nakaam huwe. In bahut si ganeemton se murad aap ke zamane aur baad ki sab ganeemtein hain. Jaldi ki ganeem se murad Khaibar ki ganeemat hai aur Hudaibiyah ki sulah hai. Masjid-e-Haram Baitullah ke asl haqdar mushrireen-e-Arab jo Quraysh thay aur jo un ke sath is ahad par thay ke woh Rasulullah ﷺ se jang karenge, un ki nisbat Quran khabar deta hai ke darasal yeh log kufr par hain, unhon hi tumhe Masjid-e-Haram Baitullah Sharif se roka hai, halanki asli haqdar aur ziyada layq Baitullah ke tum hi log thay. Phir un ki sarkashi aur mukhalifat ne unhein yahan tak andha kar diya ke Allah ki rah ki qurbaniyon ko bhi qurban-gah tak na jane diya, yeh qurbaniyan tadad mein sattar thin jaisa ke anqareeb un ka bayan aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. 

Phir farmata hai ke sardast tumhe lrai ki ijazat na dene mein yeh raz poshida thay ke abhi chand kamzor Musalman Makkah mein aise hain jo un zalimon ki wajah se na apne iman ko zahir kar sake hain, na hijrat kar ke tum mein mil sake hain aur na tum unhein jante ho. To yoon daf'atan agar tumhe ijazat de di jati aur tum ahl-e-Makkah par chapha marte, to woh sachche pakke Musalman bhi tumhare hathon shaheed ho jate aur be-ilmi mein tum hi mustahiq-e-gunah aur mustahiq-e-diyyat ban jate. Pas un kuffar ki saza ko Allah ne kuch aur peechhe hata diya takay un kamzor Musalmanon ko chhutkara mil jaye aur bhi jin ki qismat mein iman hai woh iman le ayen. 

Agar yeh momin un mein na hote to yaqinan hum tumhe un kuffar par abhi usi waqt ghalba de dete aur un ka nam mita dete. Hazrat Junaid bin Sabiq farmate hain: Subah ko main kafiron ke sath mil kar Rasulullah ﷺ se lrah raha tha lekin usi sham ko Allah Ta'ala ne mera dil pher diya, main Musalman ho gaya aur ab Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ho kar kafiron se lrah raha tha, hamare hi bare mein yeh ayat (Law la rijaal) al-ayah nazil hui hai, hum kul nau shakhs thay saat mard aur auratein (Tabarani). 

Aur rivayat mein hai ke hum teen mard thay aur nau auratein thin. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain: Agar yeh momin un kafiron mein mile jule na hote to Allah Ta'ala usi waqt Musalmanon ke hathon un kafiron ko sakht saza deta, yeh qatl kar diye jate. 

Phir farmata hai jabke yeh kafir apne dilon mein ghairat-o-hamiyyat-e-Jahiliyyat ko jama chuke thay, sulh-nama mein ayat (Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) likhne se inkar kar diya, Huzoor ﷺ ke nam ke sath lafz 'Rasulullah' ﷺ likhwane se inkar kiya, pas Allah Ta'ala ne us waqt apne Nabi aur mominon ke dil khol diye, un par apni sakeenat nazil farma kar unhein mazboot kar diya aur taqwa ke kalme par unhein jama diya yani ayat (La ilaha illallah) par, jaisa ke Ibn Abbas ka farman hai aur jaisa ke Musnad Ahmad ki marfoo' hadith mein maujood hai.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad karta rahoon jab tak ke woh ayat (La ilaha illallah) na keh lein jis ne ayat (La ilaha illallah) keh liya us ne mujh se apne maal ko aur apni jaan ko bacha liya magar haq-e-Islam ki wajah se is ka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai Allah Ta'ala ne ise apni Kitab mein nazil farmaya aik qoum ki muzammat bayan karte huwe farmaya ayat (Innahum kanuu iza qiyla lahum la ilaha illallah yastakbiroon) (As-Saffat: 35) yaani un se kaha jata tha ke siwae Allah ke koi ibadat ke laaiq nahi toh yeh takabbur karte the aur Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shana'u ne yahan Musalmanon ki taarif bayan karte huwe yeh bhi farmaya ke yahi is ke zyada haqdar aur yahi is ke qabil bhi the. Yeh kalma La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah hai unhon ne is se takabbur kiya aur mushrikin-e-Quraish ne usi se Hudaibiyah wale din takabbur kiya phir bhi Rasulullah ﷺ ne un se aik muddat-e-muayyinah ke liye sulh-nama mukammal kar liya, Ibn Jarir mein bhi yeh hadith un hi ziyadatiyon ke sath marwi hai lekin bah-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh pichle jumle rawi ke apne hain yaani Hazrat Zuhri ka qaul hai jo is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai ke goya hadith mein hi hai. Mujahid farmate hain is se murad woh ikhlas hai, Ata farmate hain woh kalma yeh hai hadith (La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadeer). Hazrat farmate hain is se murad hadith (La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah) hai. Hazrat Ali farmate hain is se hadith (La ilaha illallah wallahu akbar) murad hai yahi qaul Hazrat Ibn Umar ka hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain is se murad Allah ki wahdaniyat ki shahadat hai jo tamam taqwe ki jar hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain is se murad hadith (La ilaha illallah) bhi hai aur jihad fi sabilillah bhi hai. Hazrat Ata Khurasani farmate hain kalma-e-taqwa La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah hai. Hazrat Zuhri farmate hain ayat (Bismillahirrahmanirrahim) murad hai. Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain murad hadith (La ilaha illallah) hai. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala har cheez ko ba-khoobi janne wala hai, ise maloom hai ke mustahiq-e-khair kaun hai? aur mustahiq-e-sharr kaun hai?

Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab ki qirat isi tarah hai (Idh ja'alal-ladhina kafaru fi qulubihimul-hamiyyata hamiyyata-l-jahiliyyati walaw hamaytum kama hamuw-al-fasadal-masjidal-haram) yaani kafiron ne jis waqt apne dil mein jahilana zid paida karli agar us waqt tum bhi un ki tarah zid par ajate toh natija yeh hota ke Masjid-e-Haram mein fasad barpa hojata. Jab Hazrat Umar ko is qirat ki khabar pohanchi toh bahut tez hue lekin Hazrat Ubayy ne farmaya yeh toh aap ko bhi maloom hoga ke main Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ata jata rehta tha aur jo kuch Allah Ta'ala aap ko sikhata tha aap us mein se mujhe bhi sikhate the. Is par Janab Umar Farooq ne farmaya aap zi-ilm aur Quran-dan hain aap ko jo kuch Allah Ta'ala aur Us ke Rasool ﷺ ne sikhaya hai woh parhiye aur sikhaiye (Nasai). 

" In ahadish ka bayan jin mein Hudaibiyah ka qissa aur sulah ka waqiya hai "

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Miswar bin Makhramah aur Hazrat Marwan bin Hakam farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ ziyarat-e-Baitullah ke irade se chale, aap ka irada jang ka na tha, sattar oont qurbani ke aap ke sath the, kul sathi aap ke saat so the, aik aik oont das das admiyon ki taraf se tha. Aap jab 'Asfan pohanche toh Bishr bin Sufyan Ka'abi ne aap ko khabar di ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Quraishiyon ne aap ke ane ki khabar pa kar muqable ki taiyariyan kar li hain, unhon ne oonton ke chote chote bachche bhi apne sath le liye hain aur cheetah ki khalein pehn li hain aur ahd-o-paiman kar liye hain ke woh aap ko is tarah jabran Makkah mein nahi ane denge. Khalid bin Waleed ko unhon ne chota sa lashkar de kar Kar-e-Ghamim tak pohancha diya. Yeh sun kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya afsos Quraishiyon ko ladaiyon ne kha liya, kitni achhi baat thi ke woh mujhe aur logon ko chhod dete, agar woh mujh par ghalib ajate toh un ka maqsood poora hojata aur agar Allah Ta'ala mujhe aur logon par ghalib karde-ta toh phir yeh log bhi deen-e-Islam ko qubool kar lete aur agar us waqt bhi is deen mein na ana chahte toh mujh se ladte aur us waqt un ki taqat bhi poori hoti. Quraishiyon ne kya samajh rakha hai? Qasam Allah is deen par main un se jihad karta rahunga aur un se muqabla karta rahunga yahan tak ke ya toh Allah mujhe un par khullam khula ghalba ata farma de ya meri gardan kat jaye. Phir aap ne apne lashkar ko hukum diya ke dayin taraf Hams ke peechhe se us raste par chalein jo (Saniyat-ul-Murar) ko jata hai aur Hudaibiyah Makkah ke neeche ke hisse mein hai. Khalid wale lashkar ne jab dekha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne rasta badal diya hai toh yeh daure hue Quraishiyon ke paas gaye aur unhein is ki khabar di. Idhar Huzoor ﷺ jab (Saniyat-ul-Murar) mein pohanche toh aap ki oontni baith gayi. Log kehne lage oontni thak gayi. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya na yeh thaki na is ki baith jane ki adat, ise us Allah ne rok liya hai jis ne Makkah se hathi WPARAM ko rok liya tha.

Suno Qurish aaj mujh se jo cheez mangenge jis mein silah rahmi ho main unhein dunga phir aap ne lashkariyon ko hukum diya ke woh parao karein unhon ne kaha Ya Rasulallah ﷺ is poori wadi mein pani nahi aap ne tarkash mein se ek teer nikal kar ek sahabi ko diya aur farmaya ise yahan ke kisi kunwe mein gaar do uske gaarte hi pani josh marta hua ubal para tamam lashkar ne pani le liya aur woh barabar barhta chala ja raha tha jab parao hogya aur woh itminan se baith gaye itne mein Badeel bin Warqa apne sath Qabilah Khuzaah ke chand logon ko lekar aaya aap ne us se bhi wahi farmaya jo Bashir bin Sufyan se farmaya tha chunacha yeh laut gaya aur ja kar Qurish se kaha ke tum logon ko Huzoor ﷺ ke bare mein bari ajlat ki Huzoor ﷺ tum se larne ko nahi aaye aap to sirf Baitullah ki ziyarat karne aur uski izrat karne ko aaye hain tum apne faisle par dobara nazar dalo darasal Qabilah Khuzaah ke muslim o kafir Rasulallah ﷺ ke tarafdaar the Makkah ki khabrein unhi logon se aap ko pahuncha karti thi Qurishiyon ne unhein jawab diya ke go aap usi irade se aaye hon lekin yun achanak to hum unhein yahan nahi aane denge warna logon mein to yahi baatein hongi ke aap Makkah gaye aur koi aap ko rok na saka unhon ne phir Makrz bin Hafs ko bheja yeh Banu Amir bin Luai ke qabiley mein se tha ise dekh kar Rasulallah ﷺ ne farmaya yeh ahd shikan shakhs hai aur us se bhi aap ne wahi farmaya jo us se pehle aane wale dono aur shakhson se farmaya tha yeh bhi laut gaya aur ja kar Qurishiyon se sara waqia bayan kar diya Qurishiyon ne phir Halis bin Alqamah Kinani ko bheja yeh idhar udhar ke mukhtalif logon ka sardar tha ise dekh kar Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya yeh us qaum se hai jo Allah ke kamon ki azmat karti hai apni qurbani ke janwaron ko khara kar do. Us ne jo dekha ke har taraf se qurbani ke nishandar janwar aa ja rahe hain aur ruk jaane ki wajah se unke baal ure hue hain yeh to wahin se Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaye baghair laut gaya aur ja kar Qurish se kaha ke Allah janta hai tumhein halal nahi ke tum unhein Baitullah se roko Allah ke naam ke janwar qurbangah se ruke khare hain yeh sakht zulm hai.

Itne din ruke rehne se unke baal tak ud gaye hain main apni aankhon se dekh kar aa raha hoon. Quresh ne kaha tu to nra arabi hai khamosh ho kar baith ja. Ab unhon ne mashwara kar ke Urwah bin Mas'ud Thaqafi ko bheja. Urwah ne apne jaane se pehle kaha ke aey Qureshio jin jin ko tum ne wahan bheja woh jab wapas hue to un se tum ne kya salook kiya yeh main dekh raha hoon. Tum ne unhein bura kaha, un ki be-izzati ki, un par tuhmat rakhi, un se bad-gumani ki. Meri halat tumhein maloom hai ke main tumhein misl baap ke samajhta hoon. Tum khoob jaante ho ke jab tum ne haaye-waaye ki, main ne apni tamam qaum ko ikhatta kiya aur jis ne meri baat maani main ne use apne saath liya aur tumhari madad ke liye apni jaan, maal aur apni qaum ko le kar aa pohncha. Sab ne kaha beshak aap sachay hain humein aap se kisi qism ki bad-gumani nahi, aap jaaiye. 

Ab yeh chala aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein pohnch kar aap ke saamne baith kar kehne laga ke aap ne idhar udhar ke kuch logon ko jama kar liya hai aur aaye hain apni qaum ki shaan-o-shaukat ko aap hi todne ke liye. Sune yeh Qureshi hain aaj yeh musammam irada kar chuke hain aur chote chote bachche bhi un ke saath hain jo cheeton ki khalein pehne hue hain. Woh Allah ko beech mein rakh kar ahd-o-paiman kar chuke hain ke hargiz hargiz aap ko is tarah achanak zabardasti Makkah mein nahi aane denge. Allah ki kasam mujhe to aisa nazar aata hai ke yeh log jo is waqt bheed lagaye aap ke ird-gird khade hue hain yeh ladai ke waqt dhoondne se bhi na milenge. 

Yeh sun kar Abu Bakr Siddique R.A se raha na gaya, aap is waqt Huzoor ﷺ ke peechhe baithe hue the, aap ne kaha: "Jalat ki woh chousta rah! Hum aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ko chhor kar bhaag khade hon?" 
Urwah ne Huzoor ﷺ se poochha: "Yeh kaun hai?" 
Aap ne farmaya: "Abu Quhafah ke bete." 
Woh kehne laga: "Agar mujh par tera ehsaan pehle ka na hota to main tujhe zaroor maza chakhata." 

Is ke baad Urwah ne phir kuch kehne ke liye Rasool Allah ﷺ ki daardhi mein haath dala. Is ki is be-adabi ko Hazrat Mughirah bin Shu'bah R.A bardaasht na kar sake, yeh Huzoor ﷺ ke paas hi khade the, loha un ke haath mein tha, wahi is ke haath par maar kar farmaya: "Apna haath door rakh, tu Huzoor ﷺ ke jism ko chhoo nahi sakta." 
Yeh kehne laga: "Tu bada hi bad-zaban aur tedha aadmi hai." 
Huzoor ﷺ ne tabassum farmaya. 
Us ne poochha: "Yeh kaun hai?" 
Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh tera bhatija Mughirah bin Shu'bah hai." 
To kehne laga: "Ghadar! Tu to kal taharat bhi na jaanta tha." 

Al-gharz ise bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne wahi jawab diya jo is se pehle walon ko farmaya tha aur yaqeen dila diya ke hum ladne nahi aaye. 

Yeh wapas chala aur us ne yahan ka yeh naqsha dekha tha ke Ashab-e-Rasool ﷺ kis tarah Huzoor ﷺ ke parwane bane hue hain, aap ke wuzu ka paani woh apne haathon-haath lete hain, aap ke thook ko apne haathon mein lene ke liye woh ek doosre par sabqat karte hain, aap ka koi baal gir pade to har shakhs lapakta hai ke woh use le le. 

Jab yeh Qureshiyon ke paas pohncha to kehne laga: "Aey Quresh ki jama'at ke logo!"

Mein Kisra ke haan us ke darbar mein ho aaya hoon, Allah ki qasam maine un badshahyon ki bhi woh azmat aur woh ehteram nahi dekha jo Muhammad Rasulullah ﷺ ka hai. Aap ke ashab to aap ki woh izzat karte hain ke us se ziyada namumkin hai. Ab tum soch samajh lo aur is baat ko baawar kar lo ke Ashab-e-Rasul ﷺ aise nahi ke apne Nabi ko tumhare haathon mein de dein. 

Ab Aap ne Hazrat Umar ko bulaya aur unhein Makkah walon ke paas bhejna chaha lekin us se pehle yeh waqtia ho chuka tha ke Aap ne ek martaba Hazrat Khurash bin Umayyah Khuzai ko apne oont par jis ka naam Tha'lab tha sawar kara kar Makkah Mukarramah bheja tha. Quraish ne us oont ki kochein kaat di theen aur khud qasid ko bhi qatl kar daalte lekin Ahabish kaum ne unhein bacha liya (shayad isi bina par). 

Hazrat Umar ne jawab mein kaha ke Ya Rasul Allah ﷺ mujhe to dar hai ke kahin yeh log mujhe qatl na kar dein kyunke wahan mere qabilah Bani Adi ka koi shakhs nahi jo mujhe un Quraishiyon se bachane ki koshish kare, is liye kya yeh acha na hoga ke Aap Hazrat Usman bin Affan ko bula kar unhein Makkah mein bhejein ke ja kar Quraish se keh dein ke hum larnay ke liye nahi aaye balkisi Baitullah Sharif ki ziyarat aur us ki azmat barhanay ko aaye hain. 

Hazrat Usman ne shehar mein qadam rakha hi tha ke Aban bin Saeed bin Aas aap ko mil gaye aur apni sawari se utar kar Hazrat Usman ko aage bithaya aur khud peechhe baitha aur apni zimmedari par aap ko le chala ke aap Paigham-e-Rasul ﷺ Ahl-e-Makkah ko pohncha dein. Chunancha aap wahan gaye aur Quraish ko yeh paigham pohncha diya. Unhon ne kaha ke aap to aa hi gaye hain, aap agar chahein to Baitullah ka tawaf kar lein lekin Zun-Noorain ne jawab diya ke jab tak Huzoor ﷺ tawaf na kar lein namumkin hai ke main tawaf karoon. Quraishiyon ne Janab Usman ko rok liya aur unhein wapas na jane diya. 

Udhar lashkar-e-Islam mein yeh khabar pohnchi ke Hazrat Usman ko shaheed kar diya gaya hai. Zuhri ki riwayat mein hai ke phir Quraishiyon ne Suhail bin Amr ko aap ke paas bheja ke tum ja kar sulah kar lo lekin yeh zaroori hai ke is saal aap Makkah mein nahi aa sakte taake Arab humein yeh taana na de sakein ke woh aaye aur tum rok na sake. Chunancha Suhail yeh safarat lekar chala, jab Huzoor ﷺ ne use dekha to farmaya: "Maloom hota hai ke Quraishiyon ka irada ab sulah ka ho gaya hai jo isay bheja hai." 

Us ne Huzoor ﷺ se baatein shuru keen aur der tak sawal jawab aur baat chit hoti rahi. Shara'it-e-sulah tay ho gayeen sirf likhna baaki raha. Hazrat Umar daure hue Hazrat Abu Bakr ke paas gaye aur farmanay lage: "Kya hum musalman nahi hain? Kya yeh log mushrik nahi hain?"

Aap ne jawab diya ke haan to kaha phir kya wajah hai ke hum deeni mamlaat mein itni kamzori dikhayen, Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne farmaya Umar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ki rikaab thame raho aap Allah ke sache Rasool hain Hazrat Umar ne R.A farmaya yeh mujhe bhi kamil yaqeen hai ke aap Allah ke sache Rasool hain, Hazrat Umar R.A se phir bhi na sabar hosaka khud Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho kar isi tarah kaha aap ne jawab mein farmaya suno main Allah ka Rasool hoon aur us ka ghulam hoon main us ke farman ke khilaf nahi karsakta aur mujhe yaqeen hai ke woh mujhe zaya na karega, Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain kehne ko to us waqt josh mein main Huzoor ﷺ se yeh sab kuch keh gaya lekin phir mujhe badi nadamat hui maine us ke badle bahut rozay rakhay bahut si namazein padhein aur bahut se ghulam azad kiye us se dar kar ke mujhe is gustakhi ki koi saza Allah ki taraf se na ho, Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Ali R.A ko sulah nama likhne ke liye bulaya aur farmaya likho ayat (Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim) is par Suhail ne kaha main ise nahi janta yoon likhiye (Bismika Allahumma) aap ne farmaya acha yoon hi likho phir farmaya likho yeh woh sulah nama hai jo Muhammad Rasool Allah ﷺ ne kiya is par Suhail ne kaha agar main aap ko Rasool manta to aap se ladta hi kyun?

Yoon likhiye ke yeh woh sulh-nama hai jo Muhammad bin Abdullah (ﷺ) aur Suhail bin Amr ne kiya is baat par ke das saal tak hum mein koi ladaai na hogi log amn-o-amaan se rahenge ek dusre se bache hue rahenge aur yeh ke jo shakhsh Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas apne wali ki ijazat ke baghair chala jayega aap use wapas lota denge aur jo sahabi Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Quraishiyon ke paas chala jayega woh ise nahi lotayenge hum mein aap mein ladaaiyan band rahengi sulh qaim rahegi koi tauq-o-zanjeer qaid-o-band bhi na hoga isi mein ek shart yeh bhi thi ke jo shakhsh Muhammad (ﷺ) ki jama'at aur aap ke ahd-o-paimaan mein aana chahe woh aa sakta hai aur jo shakhsh Quraish ke ahd-o-paimaan mein aana chahe woh bhi aa sakta hai is par Banu Khuza'ah jaldi se bol uthe ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke ahd-o-paimaan mein hain aur Banu Bakr ne kaha ke hum Quraishiyon ke sath unke zimmah mein hain. Sulh-nama mein yeh bhi tha ke is saal aap wapas lot jayen Makkah mein na ayen agle saal ayen us waqt hum bahar nikal jayenge aur aap apne ashab samit ayen teen din Makkah mein thehren hathiyar utne hi hon jitne ek sawar ke paas hote hain talwar miyan mein ho, abhi sulh-nama likha ja raha tha ke Suhail ke larke Hazrat Abu Jandal (R.A) lohe ki bhaari zanjeeron mein jakde hue girte parte Makkah se chupte chupate bhag kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaye. Sahaba-e-Kiram Rizanullahi Ajma'in Madina se nikalte hue hi fateh ka yaqeen kiye hue the kyunke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) khwab dekh chuke the isliye unhe fateh hone mein zara sa bhi shak na tha yahan akar jo yeh rang dekha ke sulh ho rahi hai aur baghair tawaf ke baghair ziyarat-e-Baitullah ke yahin se wapas hona padega balke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) apne nafs par dabao daal kar sulh kar rahe hain to is se woh bahut hi pareshan khatir the balke qareeb tha ke halak ho jayen. Yeh sab kuch to tha hi mazeed bar-an jab Hazrat Abu Jandal (R.A) jo musalman the aur jinhe mushrikin ne qaid kar rakha tha aur jin par tarah tarah ke mazalim tod rahe hain yeh sun kar ke Huzoor (ﷺ) aaye hue hain kisi na kisi tarah mauqa pa kar bhag aate hain aur tauq-o-zanjeer mein jakde hue hazir-e-Huzoor (ﷺ) hote hain to Suhail uth kar unhe tamanche marna shuru kar deta hai aur kehta hai aye Muhammad (ﷺ) mere aap ke darmiyan tasfiya ho chuka hai yeh is ke baad aya hai lihaza is shart ke mutabiq mein ise wapas le jaunga aap jawab dete hain ke haan theek hai. Suhail khada hota hai aur Hazrat Abu Jandal ke gareban mein hath daal kar ghasitata hua unhe lekar chalta hai Hazrat Abu Jandal buland awaz se kehte hain aye musalmano! mujhe mushrikon ki taraf lota rahe ho?

haye yeh mera deen mujh se chheenna chahte hain is waqie ne sahabah ko aur brafrookhta kiya, Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Abu Jundal se farmaya Abu Jundal sabar kar aur naik niyat reh aur talab-e-sawab mein reh na sirf tere liye hi balki tujh jaise jitne kamzor musalman hain उन sab ke liye Allah Ta'ala rasta nikalne wala hai aur tum sab ko is dard-o-gham ranj-o-alam zulm-o-sitam se chhurwane wala hai, hum kyunki sulah kar chuke hain shartein tay ho chuki hain is bina par hum ne unhein sardast wapas kar diya hai, hum ghaddar karna, sharait ke khilaf karna, ahd-shakni karna nahi chahte. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab Hazrat Abu Jundal ke sath sath pehlu ba pehlu jaane lage aur kehte jaate the ke Abu Jundal sabar karo in mein rakha hi kya hai? Yeh mushrik log hain in ka khoon misl kutte ke khoon ke hai. Hazrat Umar sath hi sath apni talwar ki mooth Hazrat Abu Jundal ki taraf karte ja rahe the ke woh talwar kheench lein aur ek hi waar mein baap ke aar-paar kar dein lekin Hazrat Abu Jundal ka hath baap par na utha. Sulah-nama mukammal ho gaya faisla poora ho gaya. Rasoolullah ﷺ ahram mein namaz padhte the aur janwar halal hone ke liye muztarib the. Phir Huzoor ﷺ ne logon se farmaya ke utho apni apni qurbaniyan kar lo aur sar mundwa lo lekin ek bhi khada na hua teen martaba aisa hi huwa. Aap laut kar Umm-e-Salamah ke paas gaye aur farmane lage logon ko yeh kya ho gaya hai? Umm-ul-Momineen ne jawab diya ya Rasoolullah ﷺ is waqt jis qadar sadme mein yeh hain aap ko ba-khoobi ilm hai aap un se kuch na kahiye apni qurbani ke janwar ke paas jaiye aur use jahan woh ho wahin qurbaan kar dijiye aur khud sar mundwa lijiye phir to namumkin hai ke aur log bhi yahi na karein aap ne yahi kiya ab kya tha har shakhs uth khada huwa qurbani ko qurbaan kiya aur sar mundwa liya ab aap yahan se wapas chale aadha rasta tay kiya hoga jo Surah Al-Fath nazil hui, yeh riwayat Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein bhi hai is mein hai ke aap ke samne ek hazar kayi sau sahabah the, Zul-Hulaifah pahunch kar aap ne qurbani ke oonton ko nishandar kiya aur umrah ka ahram bandha aur apne ek jasus ko jo qabila Khuza'ah mein se tha tajassus ke liye rawanah kiya. Ghadeer Ashtat mein aa kar us ne khabar di ke Qurish ne poora majma tayyar kar liya hai idhar udhar ke mukhtalif logon ko bhi unhon ne jama kar liya hai aur un ka irada ladai ka aur aap ko Baitullah se rokne ka hai aap ne sahabah se farmaya ab batao kya hum un ke ahl-o-ayal par hamla kar dein agar woh hamare paas ayenge toh Allah Ta'ala ne un ki gardan kaat di hogi warna hum unhein ghamgeen chhod kar jayenge agar woh baith rahenge toh is gham-o-ranj mein rahenge aur agar unhon ne najat pali toh yeh gardanein hongi jo Allah Azzawajal ne kaat di hongi, dekho toh bhala kitna zulm hai ke hum na kisi se ladne ko aaye na kisi aur irade se aaye sirf Allah ke ghar ki ziyarat ke liye ja rahe hain aur woh hamein rok rahe hain batao un se hum kyun na ladein?

Is par Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ne farmaya, "Ya Rasulallah ﷺ! Aap Baitullah ki ziyarat ko nikle hain, aap chale chaliye, hamara irada jidal o qatal ka nahi, lekin jo hamein Allah ke ghar se roke ga hum us se zaroor ladein ge, khwah koi ho." Aap ﷺ ne farmaya, "Bas ab Allah ka naam lo aur chal khade ho." 

Kuch aur aage chal kar Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya, "Khalid bin Waleed tulaiyah ka lashkar lekar aa raha hai, pas tum dayen taraf ko ho lo." Khalid ko iski khabar bhi na hui aur Huzoor ﷺ ma'a sahabah ke unke kale par pahunch gaye. Ab Khalid dauda hua Qurayshiyon mein pahuncha aur unhein is se muttala kiya. 

Oontni ka naam is riwayat mein Qaswa bayan hua hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne jab yeh farmaya ke jo kuch woh mujh se talab karenge main doonga, bashart-e-ke hurmat-e-Allah ki ihanat na ho, phir jab aap ne oontni ko lalkara toh woh foran khari ho gayi. 

Badeel bin Warqa Khuzaee Rasulallah ﷺ ke pas ja kar Qurayshiyon ko jab jawab pahunchata hai toh Urwah bin Masood Saqafi khade ho kar apna ta'aruf kara kar, jo pehle bayan ho chuka, yeh bhi kehta hai ke, "Dekho, is shakhs ne nihayat ma'qool aur wajib baat kahi hai, ise qabool kar lo." Aur jab yeh khud hazir-e-Huzoor ﷺ ho kar aap ka yahi jawab aap ke munh se sunta hai toh aap se kehta hai, "Suniye janab! Do hi baatein hain, ya aap ghalib woh maghloob, ya woh ghalib aap maghloob. Agar pehli baat hi hui toh bhi kya hua, aap hi ki kaum hai, aap ne kisi ke bare mein aisa suna hai ke jis ne apni kaum ka satyanas kiya ho?" Aur agar doosri baat hogi toh yeh jitne aap ke pas hain, main toh dekhta hoon ke sare hi aap ko chhor chhaar daud jayenge. 

Is par Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq R.A ka woh jawab diya jo pehle guzar chuka.

Hazrat Mughirah wale bayan mein yeh bhi hai ki unke haath mein talwar thi aur sar par khud tha, unke marne par Urwah ne kaha: "Aey ghaddar! Main ne toh teri ghaddari mein tera sath diya tha." Baat yeh hai ki pehle yeh jahiliyat ke zamane mein kafiron ke ek grooh ke sath the, mauqa pa kar unhein qatal kar dala aur unka maal le kar hazir-e-khidmat-e-Aqdas ﷺ hue. Aap ne farmaya: "Tumhara Islam toh main manzoor karta hoon lekin is maal se mera koi taalluq nahi." Urwah ne yahan yeh manzar bhi ba-chashm-e-khud dekha ki Aap thookte hain toh koi na koi Sahabi lapak kar use apne haathon mein le leta hai aur apne chehre aur jism par mal leta hai. Aap ke honoton ko جنبش (junbish) hote hi farmanbardari ke liye ek se ek aage badhta hai. Jab Aap wuzu karte hain toh Aap ke aza-e-badan se gire hue pani par jo qareeb hota hai yoon lapakta hai jaise Sahaba lad paden. Jab Aap baat karte hain toh bilkul sanata ho jata hai, majal nahi jo kahin se choon ki aaz bhi sunai de. Had-e-tazeem yeh hai ki Sahaba aankh bhar kar Aap ke chehra-e-munawwar ki taraf takte hi nahi balki neechi nigahon se har waqt ba-adab rehte hain. 

Us ne phir wapas aa kar yeh hal Quraysh ko sunaya aur kaha ki Huzoor ﷺ jo insaf aur adl ki baat pesh kar rahe hain use maan lo. Banu Kinanah ke jis shakhs ko is ke baad Quraysh ne bheja, use dekh kar Huzoor-e-Akram ﷺ ne farmaya: "Yeh log qurbani ke janwaron ki badi taazeem karte hain is liye qurbani ke janwaron ko khada kar do aur is ki taraf haank do." Us ne jo yeh manzar dekha, udhar Sahaba ki zabani labbaik ki sadaen sunen toh keh utha ki in logon ko Baitullah se rokna nihayat laghw harkat hai. 

Is mein yeh bhi hai ki Kurz ko dekh kar Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh ek tajir shakhs hai." Abhi yeh baitha baatein kar hi raha tha jo Suhail aa gaya. Use dekh kar Huzoor ﷺ ne apne Sahaba se farmaya: "Lo ab kaam sahal ho gaya." Us ne jab Bismillah-e-Rahman-e-Rahim likhne par aitraz kiya toh Aap ne farmaya: "Wallah! Main Rasulullah hi hoon go tum na mano." Yeh is bina par tha ki jab Aap ki oontni baith gayi thi toh Aap ne keh diya tha ki yeh hurmat-e-Ilahi ki izzat rakhte hue mujh se jo kahenge main manzoor kar loon ga. 

Aap ne sulh-nama likhwate hue farmaya ki is saal humein yeh Baitullah ki ziyarat kar lene denge, lekin Suhail ne kaha: "Yeh humein manzoor nahi warna log kahenge ki hum dab gaye aur kuch na kar sake." Jab yeh shart ho rahi thi ki jo kafir un mein se مسلمان ho kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas chala jaye Aap use wapas kar denge, is par Musalmanon ne kaha: "SubhanAllah! Yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Ke woh Musalman ho kar aaye aur hum use kafiron ko saunp den." Yeh baatein ho rahi thin ki Hazrat Abu Jundal apni beriyon mein jakde hue aa gaye. Suhail ne kaha: "Use wapas kijiye." Aap ne farmaya: "Abhi tak sulh-nama mukammal nahi hua, main use kaise wapas kar doon?"

Usne kaha phir to Allah ki qasam main kisi tarah aur kisi shart par sulah karne mein raza-mand nahi hoon. Aapne farmaya tum khud mujhe khas is ki baabat ijazat de do. Usne kaha main is ki ijazat bhi aap ko nahi doon ga. Aapne dobara farmaya lekin usne phir bhi inkar kar diya magar Kurz ne kaha haan hum aap ko is ki ijazat dete hain. Us waqt Hazrat Abu Jandal R.A ne musalmanon se faryad ki. In becharon ko mushrikeen badi sakht sangeen sazayein kar rahe the. Is par Hazrat Umar R.A hazir-e-Huzoor ﷺ hue aur woh kaha jo pehle guzar chuka, phir pucha kya aap ne hum se yeh nahi kaha ke yeh isi saal hoga? Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main phir Abu Bakr R.A ke paas aaya aur wahi kaha jis ka oopar bayan guzra, is mein itna aur hai ke kya Huzoor ﷺ Allah ke Rasool ﷺ nahi? Is ke jawab mein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A ne farmaya haan. Phir maine Huzoor ﷺ ki peshin-goi ka isi tarah zikr kiya aur wahi jawab mujhe mila jo zikr hua, jo jawab khud Rasool Kareem ﷺ ne diya tha. 

Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ne apne hath se apne oont ko nahr kiya aur nai ko bula kar sar mundwa liya, phir to sab sahaba ek sath khade ho gaye aur qurbaniyon se farigh ho kar ek dusre ka sar khud mundne lage aur maare gham ke aur izdiham ke qareeb tha ke aapas mein lad padhein. 

Is ke baad iman wali auratein Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ayin jin ke bare mein aayat: 
(يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِذَا جَاۗءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنٰتُ مُهٰجِرٰتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوْهُنَّ ۭ اَللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِـاِيْمَانِهِنَّ ۚ فَاِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوْهُنَّ مُؤْمِنٰتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوْهُنَّ اِلَى الْكُفَّارِ ۭ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّوْنَ لَهُنَّ ۭ وَاٰتُوْهُمْ مَّآ اَنْفَقُوْا ۭ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ اَنْ تَنْكِحُوْهُنَّ اِذَآ اٰتَيْتُمُوْهُنَّ اُجُوْرَهُنَّ ۭ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوْا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَاسْـَٔــلُوْا مَآ اَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْـَٔــلُوْا مَآ اَنْفَقُوْا ۭ ذٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللّٰهِ ۭ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ) 
(Surah (Al-Mumtahina: 10) nazil hui aur Hazrat Umar R.A ne is hukm ke matahat apni do mushrika biwiyon ko isi din talaq de di, jin mein se ek ne Muawiyah bin Abu Sufyan se nikah kar liya aur dusri ne Safwan bin Umayyah se nikah kar liya.

An-Hazrat ﷺ yehi se wapas laut kar Madina Sharif aa gaye. Abu Basir naam ek Qurashi jo musalman thay, mauqa pa kar Makkah se nikal kar Rasoolullah ﷺ ke paas Madina Sharif pohanche. Unke peeche hi do kafir Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir huway aur arz kiya ke ahad-nama ki bina par is shakhs ko aap wapas kijiye, hum Qurashiyon ke bheje huway qasid hain aur Abu Basir ko wapas lene ke liye aaye hain. Aap ne farmaya achhi baat hai, main ise wapas kar deta hoon. Chunancha aap ne Hazrat Abu Basir ko unhe saunp diya. Yeh unhe lekar chale, jab Zul-Hulaifa pohanche aur be-fikri se wahan khajoorein khane lage, to Hazrat Abu Basir ne un mein se ek shakhs se kaha: Wallah, main dekh raha hoon ke aap ki talwar nihayat aamda hai. Us ne kaha: Haan, beshak bahut hi achhe lohe ki hai, main ne barha is ka tajruba kar liya hai, is ki kaat ka kya poochna hai? Yun kehte huway us ne talwar miyan se nikal li. Hazrat Abu Basir ne haath barha kar kaha: Zara mujhe dikhana. Us ne de di, aap ne haath mein lete hi tol kar ek hi vaar mein us ek kafir ka to kaam tamam kiya, doosra us rang ko dekhte hi mutthiyan band kar ke aisa sar-pat bhaga ke seedha Madina pohanch kar dam liya. Use dekhte hi Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Yeh bari ghabrahat mein hai, koi khaufnak manzar dekh chuka hai. Itne mein yeh qareeb pohanch gaya aur duhaiyan dene laga ke Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Mera sathi to maar dala gaya aur main bhi ab thore dam ka mehman hoon, dekhiye woh aaya. Itne mein Hazrat Abu Basir pohanch gaye aur arz karne lage: Ya Rasoolullah ﷺ! Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke zimme ko poora kar diya, aap ne apne wade ke mutabiq mujhe unke hawale kar diya, ab yeh Allah Ta'ala ki karimi hai ke us ne mujhe un se rehai dilwai. Aap ne farmaya: Afsos, yeh kaisa shakhs hai?

Yeh to ladaai ki aag bhadkaanewala hai, kaash ke koi ise samjha deta. Yeh sunte hi Hazrat Abu Basir chaunk gaye ke maloom hota hai aap shayad mujhe dobara mushrikeen ke hawale kar denge. Yeh sochte hi Huzoor ﷺ ke paas se chale gaye, Madina ko alvida kaha aur lambe qadmon samundar ke kinaare ki taraf chal diye aur wahin bod-o-baash ikhtiyar kar li. Yeh waqia mashhoor ho gaya. Idhar se Abu Jandal bin Suhail, jinhein Hudaibiya mein isi tarah Rasool Allah ﷺ ne wapas kiya tha, woh bhi mauqa pa kar Makkah se bhaag khade hue aur bil-wasitah Hazrat Abu Basir ke paas chale aaye. Ab yeh hua ke mushrikeen-e-Quraish mein se jo bhi iman qubool karta, seedha Hazrat Abu Basir ke paas aa jata aur yahin rehta sehta, yahan tak ke ek khaas maqool jamaat aise hi logon ki yahan jama ho gayi aur unhon ne yeh karna shuru kiya ke Quraishiyon ka jo qafila Shaam ki taraf jaane ke liye nikalta, yeh us se jang karte, jis mein Quraishi kuffar qatl bhi hue aur un ke maal bhi in muhajir musalmano ke haath lage, yahan tak ke Quraish tang aa gaye. Bal-akhir unhon ne Allah ke Paighambar ﷺ ki khidmat mein aadmi ko bheja ke Huzoor ﷺ ham par raham farma kar in logon ko wahan se wapas bula lijiye, hum un se dast-bardaar hote hain, in mein se jo bhi aap ke paas aa jaye woh aman mein hai, hum aap ko apni rishtedaariyan yaad dilate hain aur Allah ka vasta dete hain ke unhein apne paas bula lo. Chunancha Huzoor ﷺ ne is darkhwast ko manzoor farma liya aur in hazrat ke paas ek aadmi bhej kar sab ko bula liya aur Allah Azza wa Jal ne ayat: (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ كَفَّ اَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ وَاَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ اَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۭ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرًا 24) (Al-Fath: 24) nazil farmaayi.

In kuffar ki hamiyat-e-jahiliyat yeh thi ke unhon ne ayat-e-(Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) na likhne di, aap ke naam ke sath Rasool Allah na likhne diya, aap ko Baitullah Sharif ki ziyarat na karne di. Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki Kitab-ut-Tafsir mein hai, Habib bin Abu Thabit kehte hain: Main Abu Wail ke paas gaya taake un se poochon. Unhon ne kaha: Hum Siffeen mein the, ek shakhs ne kaha: Kya tune unhein nahi dekha ke woh Kitabullah ki taraf bulaye jaate hain? Pas Hazrat Ali bin Abu Talib ne farmaya: Haan. Pas Suhail bin Hunaif ne kaha: Apni janon par tuhmat rakho, hum ne apne aap ko Hudaibiya wale din dekha, yani us sulh ke mauqa par jo Nabi ﷺ aur mushrikeen ke darmiyan hui thi, agar hamari raye ladne ki hoti toh hum yaqinan ladte. Hazrat Umar ne aa kar kaha ke kya hum haq par aur woh baatil par nahi? Kya hamare maqtool jannati aur un ke maqtool jahannami nahi? Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Haan. Kaha: Phir hum kyun apne deen mein jhuk jayen aur laut jayen?

Halanki ab tak Allah Ta'ala ne hum mein un mein koi faisla-kun karwai nahi ki, An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aiye Ibn Khatab! Main Allah ka Rasool hoon, woh mujhe kabhi bhi zaye na karega." Yeh jawab sun kar Hazrat Umar (R.A) laut aaye lekin bohat gusse mein thay. Wahan se Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ke paas aaye aur yahi sawal-o-jawab yahan bhi huwe aur Surah-e-Fath nazil hui. 

Ba'z riwayat mein Hazrat Suhail bin Haneef (R.A) ke yeh alfaaz bhi hain ke, "Maine apne aap ko Abu Jandal wale din dekha ke agar mujh mein Rasool Allah ﷺ ke hukum ko lautane ki qudrat hoti toh main yaqinan loota deta." Is mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Surah-e-Fath utri toh Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko bula kar yeh surat unhein sunai. 

Musnad Ahmad ki riwayat mein hai ke, "Jis waqt yeh shart tay hui ke un ka aadmi unhein wapas kiya jaye aur hamara aadmi woh wapas na karenge, toh Huzoor ﷺ se kaha gaya ke kya hum yeh bhi maan lein? aur likh dein? Aap ne farmaya, 'Haan, is liye ke hum mein se jo un mein jaye, Allah use hum se door hi rakhe.'" (Sahih Muslim)

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke jab Khawarij nikal khade huwe aur unhon ne alahadgi ikhtiyar ki, toh maine un se kaha, "Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hudaibiyah wale din jab Mushrikeen se sulah ki toh Mushrikeen ne kaha, 'Agar hum aap ko Rasool Allah ﷺ mante toh aap se hargiz na ladte.' Toh aap ne farmaya, 'Ali! Ise mita do. Allah toh khoob janta hai ke main tera Rasool hoon, Ali! Ise kaat do aur likho: Yeh woh sharait hain jin par sulah ki Muhammad bin Abdullah ﷺ ne.' Allah ki qasam! Rasool Allah ﷺ Hazrat Ali (R.A) se bohat behtar thay phir bhi aap ne is likhe huwe ko katvaya, is se kuch aap Nubuwwat se nahi nikal gaye."

Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hudaibiyah wale din sattar oont qurban kiye, jin mein ek oont Abu Jahl ka bhi tha. Jab yeh oont Baitullah se rok diye gaye toh is tarah nala-o-baka karte thay jaise kisi se uska doodh peeta bacha alag ho gaya ho.)

Masjid-e-Haram Baitullah ke asl haqdar mushrireen-e-Arab jo Quraysh thay aur jo un ke sath is ahad par thay ke woh Rasulullah ﷺ se jang karenge, un ki nisbat Quran khabar deta hai ke darasal yeh log kufr par hain, unhon hi tumhe Masjid-e-Haram Baitullah Sharif se roka hai, halanki asli haqdar aur ziyada layq Baitullah ke tum hi log thay. Phir un ki sarkashi aur mukhalifat ne unhein yahan tak andha kar diya ke Allah ki rah ki qurbaniyon ko bhi qurban-gah tak na jane diya, yeh qurbaniyan tadad mein sattar thin jaisa ke anqareeb un ka bayan aa raha hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. 

Phir farmata hai ke sardast tumhe lrai ki ijazat na dene mein yeh raz poshida thay ke abhi chand kamzor Musalman Makkah mein aise hain jo un zalimon ki wajah se na apne iman ko zahir kar sake hain, na hijrat kar ke tum mein mil sake hain aur na tum unhein jante ho. To yoon daf'atan agar tumhe ijazat de di jati aur tum ahl-e-Makkah par chapha marte, to woh sachche pakke Musalman bhi tumhare hathon shaheed ho jate aur be-ilmi mein tum hi mustahiq-e-gunah aur mustahiq-e-diyyat ban jate. Pas un kuffar ki saza ko Allah ne kuch aur peechhe hata diya takay un kamzor Musalmanon ko chhutkara mil jaye aur bhi jin ki qismat mein iman hai woh iman le ayen. 

Agar yeh momin un mein na hote to yaqinan hum tumhe un kuffar par abhi usi waqt ghalba de dete aur un ka nam mita dete. Hazrat Junaid bin Sabiq farmate hain: Subah ko main kafiron ke sath mil kar Rasulullah ﷺ se lrah raha tha lekin usi sham ko Allah Ta'ala ne mera dil pher diya, main Musalman ho gaya aur ab Huzoor ﷺ ke sath ho kar kafiron se lrah raha tha, hamare hi bare mein yeh ayat (Law la rijaal) al-ayah nazil hui hai, hum kul nau shakhs thay saat mard aur auratein (Tabarani). 

Aur rivayat mein hai ke hum teen mard thay aur nau auratein thin. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain: Agar yeh momin un kafiron mein mile jule na hote to Allah Ta'ala usi waqt Musalmanon ke hathon un kafiron ko sakht saza deta, yeh qatl kar diye jate. 

Phir farmata hai jabke yeh kafir apne dilon mein ghairat-o-hamiyyat-e-Jahiliyyat ko jama chuke thay, sulh-nama mein ayat (Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim) likhne se inkar kar diya, Huzoor ﷺ ke nam ke sath lafz 'Rasulullah' ﷺ likhwane se inkar kiya, pas Allah Ta'ala ne us waqt apne Nabi aur mominon ke dil khol diye, un par apni sakeenat nazil farma kar unhein mazboot kar diya aur taqwa ke kalme par unhein jama diya yani ayat (La ilaha illallah) par, jaisa ke Ibn Abbas ka farman hai aur jaisa ke Musnad Ahmad ki marfoo' hadith mein maujood hai.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main logon se jihad karta rahoon jab tak ke woh ayat (La ilaha illallah) na keh lein jis ne ayat (La ilaha illallah) keh liya us ne mujh se apne maal ko aur apni jaan ko bacha liya magar haq-e-Islam ki wajah se is ka hisab Allah Ta'ala ke zimme hai Allah Ta'ala ne ise apni Kitab mein nazil farmaya aik qoum ki muzammat bayan karte huwe farmaya ayat (Innahum kanuu iza qiyla lahum la ilaha illallah yastakbiroon) (As-Saffat: 35) yaani un se kaha jata tha ke siwae Allah ke koi ibadat ke laaiq nahi toh yeh takabbur karte the aur Allah Ta'ala Jalla Shana'u ne yahan Musalmanon ki taarif bayan karte huwe yeh bhi farmaya ke yahi is ke zyada haqdar aur yahi is ke qabil bhi the. Yeh kalma La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah hai unhon ne is se takabbur kiya aur mushrikin-e-Quraish ne usi se Hudaibiyah wale din takabbur kiya phir bhi Rasulullah ﷺ ne un se aik muddat-e-muayyinah ke liye sulh-nama mukammal kar liya, Ibn Jarir mein bhi yeh hadith un hi ziyadatiyon ke sath marwi hai lekin bah-zahir yeh maloom hota hai ke yeh pichle jumle rawi ke apne hain yaani Hazrat Zuhri ka qaul hai jo is tarah bayan kiya gaya hai ke goya hadith mein hi hai. Mujahid farmate hain is se murad woh ikhlas hai, Ata farmate hain woh kalma yeh hai hadith (La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shai'in qadeer). Hazrat farmate hain is se murad hadith (La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah) hai. Hazrat Ali farmate hain is se hadith (La ilaha illallah wallahu akbar) murad hai yahi qaul Hazrat Ibn Umar ka hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain is se murad Allah ki wahdaniyat ki shahadat hai jo tamam taqwe ki jar hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair farmate hain is se murad hadith (La ilaha illallah) bhi hai aur jihad fi sabilillah bhi hai. Hazrat Ata Khurasani farmate hain kalma-e-taqwa La ilaha illallah Muhammadur Rasulullah hai. Hazrat Zuhri farmate hain ayat (Bismillahirrahmanirrahim) murad hai. Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain murad hadith (La ilaha illallah) hai. Phir farmata hai Allah Ta'ala har cheez ko ba-khoobi janne wala hai, ise maloom hai ke mustahiq-e-khair kaun hai? aur mustahiq-e-sharr kaun hai?

Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab ki qirat isi tarah hai (Idh ja'alal-ladhina kafaru fi qulubihimul-hamiyyata hamiyyata-l-jahiliyyati walaw hamaytum kama hamuw-al-fasadal-masjidal-haram) yaani kafiron ne jis waqt apne dil mein jahilana zid paida karli agar us waqt tum bhi un ki tarah zid par ajate toh natija yeh hota ke Masjid-e-Haram mein fasad barpa hojata. Jab Hazrat Umar ko is qirat ki khabar pohanchi toh bahut tez hue lekin Hazrat Ubayy ne farmaya yeh toh aap ko bhi maloom hoga ke main Huzoor ﷺ ke paas ata jata rehta tha aur jo kuch Allah Ta'ala aap ko sikhata tha aap us mein se mujhe bhi sikhate the. Is par Janab Umar Farooq ne farmaya aap zi-ilm aur Quran-dan hain aap ko jo kuch Allah Ta'ala aur Us ke Rasool ﷺ ne sikhaya hai woh parhiye aur sikhaiye (Nasai). 

" In ahadish ka bayan jin mein Hudaibiyah ka qissa aur sulah ka waqiya hai "

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Miswar bin Makhramah aur Hazrat Marwan bin Hakam farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ ziyarat-e-Baitullah ke irade se chale, aap ka irada jang ka na tha, sattar oont qurbani ke aap ke sath the, kul sathi aap ke saat so the, aik aik oont das das admiyon ki taraf se tha. Aap jab 'Asfan pohanche toh Bishr bin Sufyan Ka'abi ne aap ko khabar di ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ Quraishiyon ne aap ke ane ki khabar pa kar muqable ki taiyariyan kar li hain, unhon ne oonton ke chote chote bachche bhi apne sath le liye hain aur cheetah ki khalein pehn li hain aur ahd-o-paiman kar liye hain ke woh aap ko is tarah jabran Makkah mein nahi ane denge. Khalid bin Waleed ko unhon ne chota sa lashkar de kar Kar-e-Ghamim tak pohancha diya. Yeh sun kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya afsos Quraishiyon ko ladaiyon ne kha liya, kitni achhi baat thi ke woh mujhe aur logon ko chhod dete, agar woh mujh par ghalib ajate toh un ka maqsood poora hojata aur agar Allah Ta'ala mujhe aur logon par ghalib karde-ta toh phir yeh log bhi deen-e-Islam ko qubool kar lete aur agar us waqt bhi is deen mein na ana chahte toh mujh se ladte aur us waqt un ki taqat bhi poori hoti. Quraishiyon ne kya samajh rakha hai? Qasam Allah is deen par main un se jihad karta rahunga aur un se muqabla karta rahunga yahan tak ke ya toh Allah mujhe un par khullam khula ghalba ata farma de ya meri gardan kat jaye. Phir aap ne apne lashkar ko hukum diya ke dayin taraf Hams ke peechhe se us raste par chalein jo (Saniyat-ul-Murar) ko jata hai aur Hudaibiyah Makkah ke neeche ke hisse mein hai. Khalid wale lashkar ne jab dekha ke Huzoor ﷺ ne rasta badal diya hai toh yeh daure hue Quraishiyon ke paas gaye aur unhein is ki khabar di. Idhar Huzoor ﷺ jab (Saniyat-ul-Murar) mein pohanche toh aap ki oontni baith gayi. Log kehne lage oontni thak gayi.
